Class GrokCallOptions

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.GrokCallOptions
public final class GrokCallOptions extends Object
The GrokCallOptions class holds the body fields for one Grok chat request. AmwpFacade fills an instance from the execute TOON. The execute TOON is the request record for one turn. The class has no top_p field. The class has no num_ctx field. The probe is the short Hello request that checks a model. The probe does not send temperature. The probe does not send maxCompletionTokens. The probe sends a completion cap of 16. // @aa-sdd G-05 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Field Details

    • FACTORY_TEMPERATURE

      public static final double FACTORY_TEMPERATURE
      The value is the temperature used for an ordinary chat request. The number is 1.0. The probe does not send this value.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • FACTORY_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS

      public static final int FACTORY_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS
      The value is the completion cap used for an ordinary chat request. The number is 128000. The probe sends 16 instead.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • thinkStream

      public boolean thinkStream
      The flag is true when the chat body sets stream to true. A false flag sends stream as false.

    • reasoningEffort

      public String reasoningEffort
      The text is the reasoning level for the chat body. An empty string becomes high when sendReasoningEffort is true.

    • sendReasoningEffort

      public boolean sendReasoningEffort
      The flag chooses whether the chat body includes reasoning_effort. A false flag leaves that field off the request. A true flag sends the level.

    • temperature

      public double temperature
      The value is the sampling temperature for a chat request. The probe leaves temperature unset.

    • maxCompletionTokens

      public int maxCompletionTokens
      The value is the completion cap for a chat request. The probe does not use this value.

  • Constructor Details

    • GrokCallOptions

      public GrokCallOptions()
      The constructor leaves the ordinary chat values in place. Thinking stays off because thinkStream starts false. sendReasoningEffort starts true.
